sources.role: closed Chapter 8 synthesis and limitations authority
dissertation objective and title-level question context

rq_wording_authority.rq1: To what extent can lightweight heads built on frozen global image and question embeddings answer closed-set GQA questions, and how do explicit interaction features, frozen-encoder choice and answer-set size affect development-set accuracy?
rq_wording_authority.rq2: As training data scales, does a lightweight 32-query latent reasoner over frozen token-level visual features improve on global-embedding heads, and do any overall gains extend to questions requiring four or more reasoning steps?
rq_wording_authority.rq3: When a frozen small language model is coupled to the latent reasoner on the question side or used as the answer readout, does pretraining improve development-set accuracy over an architecturally matched random control, and what efficiency implications are supported by the project's trainable-parameter counts and valid warm-serial latency measurements?

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: development-bounded title-level answer separating compact non-SLM frontier systems from interface-specific SLM contribution
claim_mappings.qualification: development only; SLMs can contribute but were not required for the canonical frontier; held-out validation pending

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: RQ1 answer covering viability, question-side predictive information, visual dependence, standard fusion gain, capacity-matched unresolved residual, representation confound and answer-space boundary
claim_mappings.qualification: capacity accounts for part of the original gap; the capacity-matched residual is not resolved clearly; dependence is not grounding or reasoning

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: RQ2 answer covering scale ordering, seed-consistent larger-scale accuracy gaps, configuration-level comparison, persistent deficit and unresolved paired deficit contrasts
claim_mappings.qualification: architecture, token access and capacity co-vary; higher accuracy does not remove compositional difficulty or localise its cause

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: question-side matched benefit together with below-A0p boundary, and the complete answer-side directional/uncertain pattern
claim_mappings.qualification: A1-minus-A0p is secondary and representation-confounded; uncertain results establish neither equivalence nor absence; synthesis is cross-experiment

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: A1 latency ordering, explicit canonical frontier membership, trainable-parameter context, contextual E9 status and missing comparable answer-side timing
claim_mappings.qualification: frontier contains concat, fusion and vocab1000 product only; trainable counts are not latency proxies; E9 is contextual and unpaired; R1/E10 timing incomplete

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: controlled compact frozen-representation VQA study with interaction and capacity controls
32-query latent-reasoner evaluation across training scales with token-input and compositional-profile diagnostics
claim_mappings.qualification: evaluation contribution, not a mechanism or simple negative low-data claim

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: matched pretrained-versus-random controls on both interface sides including the 360M answer-side extension
claim_mappings.qualification: matched within first-order pairs; placements remain separately run experiments

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: governed end-to-end warm-serial evaluation and canonical common-denominator accuracy-latency frontier
claim_mappings.qualification: retained E7b quantities and stated hardware only

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: supporting record separating canonical, superseded and withdrawn evidence
claim_mappings.qualification: supporting methodology only, not central scientific novelty

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: development/F2, task and answer-space, configuration-level, SLM coverage and measured-efficiency boundaries
claim_mappings.qualification: limitations narrow the conclusion and do not invalidate within-family controlled results

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: conditional governed model freeze and blinded held-out evaluation
claim_mappings.qualification: only if separately authorised; no selected system or expected result

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: capacity- and interface-matched tests separating representation from downstream architecture
claim_mappings.originating_limitation: cross-family comparisons change representation, architecture, token access, capacity or seed structure together
claim_mappings.qualification: test design only; no promised gain

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: broader SLM families, placements and lightweight adaptation to test compatibility versus scale
claim_mappings.originating_limitation: small set of frozen SLM families, sizes, placements and differing experiment-family selection contexts
claim_mappings.qualification: hypothesis test only; no claim that adaptation improves accuracy

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: prior-controlled compositional analysis and valid answer-side latency/corrected-boundary memory measurement
